name: rat
description: RAT — Repo Analysis Tool: a web dashboard that computes file, directory, repository, commit-set and author metrics for git repositories.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
